info.title: Follow Up Boss (fub-mcp trimmed for Custom GPT Actions)
info.description: A curated ~24-operation subset of the Follow Up Boss CRM API for on-the-go use as a ChatGPT Custom GPT Action. Each user authenticates with their OWN Follow Up Boss personal API key (HTTP Basic auth) — this schema is not tied to any single account. See gpt/SETUP.md for exact auth setup steps, and gpt/gpt-instructions.md for the GPT's behavior instructions (defaults, gotchas, custom field handling).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID(s) of a person or people. (e.g., "123,456")

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The sort order, can be one of the following: `id`, `created`, `updated`, `name`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `price`, `stage`, `lastActivity`, `lastCommunication`, `lastReceivedEmail`, `lastSentEmail`, `lastEmail`, `emailsReceived`, `emailsSent`, `lastIncomingCall`, `lastOutgoingCall`, `lastCall`, `firstCall`, `callsIncoming`, `callsOutgoing`, `callsDuration`, `lastReceivedText`, `lastSentText`, `lastText`, `lastLeadActivity`, `lastEmEventActivity`, `lastIdxVisit`, `textsReceived`, `textsSent`, `propertiesViewed`, `propertiesSaved`, `pagesViewed` or `nextTask`.

Custom Fields (e.g. `customClosePrice`) can also be used in sorting.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return. Max 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the number of rows to skip, before starting to return results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of fields to return or use `allFields` to return all fields. (e.g., `firstName,lastName,timeframeId,timeframeUpdated,timeframeStatus,customFieldName`). Note: All custom fields should be prefixed with `custom` (i.e. customBirthday, customField).

Special values include `allCustom` (returns all custom fields) and `allFields` (returns all fields, including custom fields).

When using the `fields` parameter to filter the response, the `id` field will be included (even when not specified explicitly).

parameters.name: lastActivityAfter
parameters.description: Search for last activity after a given time. (e.g., "2016-11-23 01:02:03")

parameters.name: lastActivityBefore
parameters.description: Search for last activity before a given time. (e.g., "2016-11-23 01:02:03")

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search for person with a name like what is given. (e.g., If you search for "drew", it might return a contact like "Andrew".)

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Search for person with a first name like what is given. (e.g., If you search for "drew", it might return a contact like "Andrew".)

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Search for person with a last name like what is given. (e.g., If you search for "drew", it might return a contact like "Andrew".)

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Search for a person by email address.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Search for a person by phone number.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Search for person by stage name. (e.g., "Lead" or "Trash". See [stages API endpoint](ref:stages-get) for available stages.)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Search for a person by lead source.

parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.description: Search for a person by the user that is assigned to them. (e.g., Passing "William Riker" would return any person assigned to them.)

parameters.name: assignedUserId
parameters.description: Search for people by the assigned user ID.

parameters.name: assignedPondId
parameters.description: Search for a person by the assigned pond id.

parameters.name: assignedLenderName
parameters.description: Search for people by the assigned lender name.

parameters.name: assignedLenderId
parameters.description: Search for people by the assigned lender user ID.

parameters.name: contacted
parameters.description: Search for people by whether or not they have been contacted.

parameters.name: priceAbove
parameters.description: Search for people who have specified a price above a given value.

parameters.name: priceBelow
parameters.description: Search for people who have specified a price below a given value.

parameters.name: smartListId
parameters.description: Search for people that match a smart list with given ID.

parameters.name: includeTrash
parameters.description: Set whether to include people in the "trash" stage. (By default responses from /people will not include any people with a "trash" stage.)

parameters.name: includeUnclaimed
parameters.description: Set to include unclaimed leads offered to the current user.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Search for people that match one or more tags. (e.g., "Foo,Bar" will match contacts with tags that include Foo OR Bar.)

parameters.name: custom*
parameters.description: You can include any of your Custom Fields in the request, these must be prefixed with "custom".  For example, if you have a *Closing Date* custom field, the JSON key for that field will be `customClosingDate`.  See [Custom Fields](doc:custom-fields-get) for more about Custom Fields.

parameters.name: deduplicate
parameters.description: By default new people will be created even if there are existing people with the same email or phone. By passing true, deduplication logic will be used and, if a person is found, a 200 response will be returned along with response data for that existing person. No changes will be made based on the payload.

createdAt.description: Will set the creation time for the person, if wanting to create historical leads.

firstName.description: The first/given name of the person.

lastName.description: The last/family name of the person.

stage.description: The stage the person is in. (e.g., "Lead" or "Trash". See [stage API endpoint](ref:stages-get) for more options.)

sourceUrl.description: This is a direct link to the information about a person at the lead provider.

contacted.description: Whether the person has been contacted or not.

price.description: The price of the property of the person's first inquiry, or the estimated sell/buy price for this person.

assignedTo.description: Full name of the agent assigned to this person.

assignedUserId.description: ID of the agent assigned to this person.

assignedPondId.description: ID of the pond assigned to this person.

assignedLenderName.description: Full name of the lender assigned to this person.

assignedLenderId.description: ID of the lender assigned to this person.

emails.description: A list of email addresses associated with the person. (Specify type and value, isPrimary is not expected. The first email in the list will be the primary email address.)

isPrimary.description: Sets whether the email address is the primary address.

phones.description: A list of phone numbers associated with the person. (Specify type and value, isPrimary is not expected. The first phone in the list will be the primary phone number.)

isPrimary.description: Sets whether this is the primary phone number.

addresses.description: A list of addresses associated with the person. (These are the addresses where this person can be contacted, it is not the address of a property this person may be interested in selling or buying).

street.description: Street address. (e.g., "3595 South Higuera St., Suite B")

code.description: Zipcode. (As a string, not a number.)

tags.description: A list of tags applied to the person.

background.description: Background information on the person. (Can be a multi-line string.)

collaborators.description: List of user ids to set as collaborators on this person. Not including a collaborator's user id in this array will remove them as a collaborator.

custom*.description: You can include any of your Custom Fields in the request, these must be prefixed with "custom".  For example, if you have a *Closing Date* custom field, the JSON key for that field will be `customClosingDate`.  See [Custom Fields](doc:custom-fields-get) for more about Custom Fields.

timeframeId.description: ID of the timeframe to move (Refer to the /timeframes endpoint for valid values of timeframeId.)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of fields to return. (e.g., `firstName,lastName,timeframeId,timeframeUpdated,timeframeStatus,customFieldName`)

Special values include `allCustom` (returns all custom fields) and `allFields` (returns all fields, including custom fields).

get.description: List notes, optionally filtered by person via personId. NOT in FUB's published docs (only GET /notes/{id} is documented) but confirmed working against the live API. Paginates via a next cursor, not offset.

parameters.name: personId
parameters.description: Only return notes for this person ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return. Max 100.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Cursor from a previous response's _metadata.next.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the note.

parameters.name: includeThreadedReplies
parameters.description: When set to true, will include threaded replies attached to the note. Replies may include HTML tags in their bodies.

parameters.name: includeReactions
parameters.description: When set to true, will include the reactions that have been left on the note (as well as the replies if those have also been requested). Reactions are keyed by the emoji reaction. The value is an array of user IDs who have left that reaction.
